title: ARIA Evidence Types Schema
description: Field-schema contract for a template's evidence_types.json artifact. Defines document types, their extraction fields, optional Azure DI model override, optional line-item fields, and the document-type-ID-to-name mapping used for runtime resolution.

doc_type_id_mapping.description: Maps external document-type IDs (strings) to canonical doc_type names. Used by the template loader to resolve a submission's documentTypeId to the doc_type key used throughout the schema.

document_types.description: Ordered list of document type definitions. Each entry fully describes one document type's extraction contract.

doc_type.description: Canonical document type identifier (e.g. 'Invoice', 'Halal_Slaughter_Certificate'). Must be unique within the document_types array.

di_model.description: Optional Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt model ID to use for Phase-1 structured extraction (e.g. 'prebuilt-invoice'). Omit to use the default layout model.

doc_notes.description: Optional extraction hints injected verbatim into the LLM system prompt for this document type. Use for document-specific parsing instructions.

fields.description: Ordered list of canonical field names to extract from this document type. The order influences LLM prompt construction.

line_item_fields.description: Optional list of field names to extract per repeating row (e.g. invoice product rows). When present, the LLM is instructed to populate a 'line_items' array in addition to top-level key_value_pairs.
